sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras, 1x Camera Charger.
Morning shift deployed. Ops phone battery low at 6%; patrol placed on standby while recharging. Team available for response calls.
Welfare check at Starbucks. No issues. Brief morning coffee stop before patrolling along Queen Street.
Arrived at Queen Street / Wyndham Street. Area inspected. All clear.
Arrived at Queen Street / Shortland Street. No issues requiring assistance.
Visual inspection at Pocket Park. No concerns.
Arrived at Imperial Lane. Floor checks completed on ground floor and Level 1. No issues.
Departed standby due to no incidents requiring assistance.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full walkthrough with welfare checks throughout the precinct. No issues.
Ops phone battery reached 30%. Patrol duties resumed.
Welfare checks along Queens Wharf businesses. All clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop. No issues.
Welfare checks at Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths. Brief refreshment stop. No issues.
Arrived at Customs Street / Albert Street. Area inspected. All clear.
Welfare checks at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at Albert Street / Swanson Street. No issues.
Walkthrough at Federal Square and the Cathedral precinct. No concerns.
Departed standby due to no incidents requiring assistance.
Arrived at Albert Street / Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Cafe, and Barclay Suites. All clear.
Welfare checks at Little Albert's Cafe, Formery, The People's Barista, and Sky Mart Convenience Store. No issues.
Returned to HQ. Debrief with second team. Teams separated to cover allocated upper and lower CBD sectors.
Arrived at High Street / Victoria Street. Welfare checks across surrounding businesses. All clear.
Patrol through Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. Inspected for vagrants / disorder. No issues.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Full sweep completed. No issues.
Patrol resumed following no incidents requiring assistance.
Welfare checks throughout O'Connell Lane, Vulcan Lane, and lower High Street businesses.
Arrived at Wilson Parking. Full sweep with welfare checks on businesses and static personnel. All clear.
Arrived at lower Fort Street. Welfare checks at Sienna Cafe, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo, Chargrill, and surrounding businesses. No issues.
No incidents or concerns. Patrol continued.
Arrived at Kiwibank. Welfare checks at Mr Katsu, 77 Convenience Store, The Coffee Club, Evans Kebabs, Tuck Shop, St Pierre's Sushi, and Queens Arcade. All secure.
Welfare checks at Four Square, Movenpick, and Adidas. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart and throughout the precinct. No issues.
Security presence maintained while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check at the end of Queens Wharf. No problematic behaviour; members of the public fishing without incident.
Returned towards HQ for brief operational debrief with second team.
Welfare check at Glassons. Staff expressed appreciation for assistance during the previous day's incident. No issues today.
Arrived at HQ and took a short operational break.
Patrol resumed following sector change. First team assumed the upper CBD sector. Welfare checks completed (all secure) at:
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full inspection and sweep completed. No issues.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. Area inspected. No issues.
Welfare checks at Queens Food Court, Munster Inn, and Nando's. All clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library. No issues.
Arrived at Lorne Street / Wellesley Street. Welfare checks along Lorne Street. All clear.
Returned to HQ; remained available for response calls while completing Auror incident reports.
Scheduled lunch break commenced while Auror documentation continued.
Administrative: Auror report completed re male defecating behind 220 Queen Street; Auror report completed re the aggressive male from the Glassons incident.

sections.title: Day / Evening Shift — Team 2 (09:05 – 17:00)
items: Team 2 briefing: welfare checks for issues minor or major; visible presence in theft/problem areas; assist lost members of the public.
Commenced patrols toward Aotea Square. Welfare check-ins conducted at:
Checked in at Aotea Square. Commenced full sweep.
Full sweep of Aotea Square complete. All clear. Standing by for presence and to monitor for vagrants / problematic behaviour.
Checked in at Mayoral Drive. Welfare check on Te Waihorotiu train station guard. All clear.

Checked in at top of Victoria Street (welfare check on 77 Convenience). One male vagrant became aggressive on arrival and was verbally abusive in his native tongue. He crossed towards Amelia's Cafe, picked up a chair and approached; as guards moved to address him he ran off with the chair towards Hobson Street. Standing by in case the POI returns.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street West. Welfare checks along Victoria Street West down to Queen Street. All clear.

Patrolling back up Queen Street, observed a male vagrant yelling at and disturbing World Vision volunteers. Approached and advised him to move along so the workers could continue; he complied. Standing by.
Checked in at Auckland Library. Full sweep. All clear.
Checked in at corner of Lorne Street / Victoria Street East. Welfare checks along Lorne Street:

Incident note (historical) — Tsujiri, 06/03/26 16:00: female, curly brown hair, rainbow jacket with a kitten, entered the store and trashed all displays inside (photo on file). Same POI associated with Bao & Noodles and Meat Fresh.
Standing by at bottom of Victoria Street West for presence and to monitor for vagrants.
Heading back up Victoria Street West. Welfare check-ins at Woolworths, Tony's Steakhouse, Scrunchy Millers, and Liquor City.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commenced full sweep.
Full sweep of Aotea Square complete. All clear. Returning to HQ for combined 10-minute interval.
Checked in at Queens Court. Welfare check. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Received response call from Team 1 regarding a female vagrant obstructing the entrance of 27 Victoria Street West.
Arrived at 27 Victoria Street West. Female had already been moved along by Council but was spotted across the road outside 205 Queen Street.
Spoke with the individual and advised her not to obstruct business entrances; she complied and moved along. Standing by in case she returns.
Arrived at corner of Wellesley Street / Queen Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street fountain. Standing by for presence and monitoring.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street East. Standing by outside HQ. Welfare checks at Puffing Kiwi, Starbucks, and Sail City Mart.
Briefing / 'Day in the Life of HOTC' completed. Commenced 30-minute meal break.
Evening shift (Team 2) completed. Equipment handover (2x Vests).

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Afternoon shift deployed. Guards stood by at HQ while Ops phone charged.

Response call from Nike regarding a male who had stolen from the store (photo description provided), seen heading up Queen Street towards Aotea Square. Guards located the male running into McDonald's Queen Street.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. Guards approached the male and requested return of the stolen Nike goods; he complied and handed them over. Auror report to be completed.
Returned stolen items to Nike Queen Street. Security presence maintained.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Welfare checks along Queen Street. All clear.
Aotea Square sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive. Welfare check with Te Waihorotiu train station guard. All clear.

Arrived at top of Victoria Street West. Welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store, Amelia's Cafe, Coffee Club, Vphix Mobiles, Mr Tacos, JD Convenience Store, People's Barista, Little Albert's Cafe, Formery, Skymart, Scrunchy Millers, City Liquor, and AA Insurance. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street. Full sweep commenced down to Auckland Library.
Full sweep of Lorne Street and Auckland Library completed. Welfare checks along Lorne Street. All clear.
Welfare check at Queens Court. All clear. Guards headed back down Queen Street.
Guards stood by outside Mid City / 77 Convenience Store maintaining presence.
Arrived at Darby Street. Male vagrant observed sitting outside Celine's under the influence of legal substances. Guards advised him to move along; he complied. Auror report completed.
Arrived at bottom of Queen Street. Welfare checks along Queen Street and McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at Gore Street. Fort Street sweep and welfare checks commenced.

Arrived at Jean Batten Street. Welfare checks at Giapo, Chargrill, King Made Noodles, Sal's Pizza, Sienna's, 77 Convenience, Auckland Harbour Suites, P&K Liquor, Smiley Mart, Right Track, Jo & Joe, Walker & Hall, Hoka, North Face, and KFC. All clear.
Returned to HQ for combined 20-minute interval before floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Guards stood by at HQ to charge Ops phone (percentage on office camera).
Arrived at Darby Street check-in. Welfare checks at Celine's, Mali Thai, Pizza Club, Tandoori, Tank, and Domino's. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street West. Welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and The Fiddler. All clear.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square check-in.
St Patrick's Square sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at QF Tavern, Ibis Budget Hotel, and Ace Karaoke. All clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at Fort Street. Welfare checks on all stores. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Square and Chancery Square.
Freyberg Square and Chancery Square sweep completed. No issues. Echo Route ended. Guards stood by.
Response call from 102 Albert Street regarding a male inside the building refusing to leave after breaching building policy.
Arrived at 102 Albert Street. Building manager showed guards the male and his room. Guards informed him he had to leave; he complied.

Outside 102 Albert Street, guards issued the male a trespass notice on behalf of 102 Albert Street. He requested guidance to another backpackers nearby and guards escorted him. Bodycam footage captured and Auror report filed.
Arrived back at HQ awaiting night shift handover.
Afternoon shift completed. Handover to night shift completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:45 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Check-in at Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu. No issues.
Commercial Bay patrol commenced. Full sweep underway.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare check at Albert Street Convenience Store. No issues.
Ace Karaoke checked. No issues. Guards returned to HQ.
Patrol commenced at Aotea Square. Full sweep underway.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear.
McDonald's Queen Street checked. No issues.
Full sweep at Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street. All clear.
Full sweep at Fort Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear.
Gore Street checked. All clear. Beta Route complete.
St Patrick's Square full sweep completed. All clear.
Victoria Street full sweep completed. All clear.
Corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield Street checked. All clear.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male smoking inside the premises.
Guards arrived and asked the male to move along. He complied. No further issues.
Guards returned to HQ to charge Ops phone.
Corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield Street checked. All clear.
McDonald's Queen Street checked. No issues. Returned to HQ for break.
Guards stood by at HQ to charge Ops phone (very low).
Patrol along upper Queen Street until changeover.

Serious / notable: Nike theft recovery — male located at McDonald's and goods returned (15:13). 102 Albert Street trespass notice issued (21:15, bodycam on file). Male vagrant under influence moved on from Celine's / Darby Street (16:55). Male smoking inside McDonald's Queen Street moved on (03:24). Aggressive male vagrant with chair at top of Victoria Street — Team 2 (09:50).
